server.note: The harness spawns and stops its own Dock dev server. Ports 3000/3001 belong to another local project and are never bound, probed or killed. The probe of http://127.0.0.1:3112/api/v1 answered, so data-backed screens are measured on their live branch. This run's hub is whatever live-hub reached — not necessarily the deployed one.

Recorded as a skip with a reason instead of a green tile; the detail screen needs a running hub (or a seeded fixture) before it can be evidenced.
